statements.statement: The patient presents with a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
The patient has intermittent palpitations and lightheadedness
There is concern for an underlying paroxysmal arrhythmia
The symptoms are episodic in nature
A cardiac event monitoring study (CPT 93271) is indicated
The diagnosis codes are I49.9 and G45.9
Less intensive monitoring options were attempted and deemed inadequate prior to initiating this level of diagnostic testing
